Messages.Author: Steinar
Messages.Body:
Hi!

Can i play revelation of ecstasy on superior serpentis on a tapped minion?

If i compare it to deep song, where you can enter combat even though the minion is tapped, I think I can.

Anyobody knows?

Thanks!

Revelation of Ecstasy [LotN:C/PS4]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Serpentis
+1 stealth action.
[ser]  Tap one of your prey's ready minions.
[SER] As above, and place a corruption counter on that minion. If the number of your corruption counters on the minion equals or exceeds his or her capacity or cost, you may burn those counters to take control of him or her.
Artist: Jim DiBartolo

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body:
yes, you can.

unlike Mind Numb, which specifically requires the target to be untapped.

Messages.Author: Steinar
Messages.Body: Thank you! And now to make a deck with it!!

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Correct. Tapping a tapped minion as an effect works on tapped minions. Tapping a tapped minion as a cost is not something you can do.
